observations: PlayerMixin uses synchronized CompoundTag CarryOnData, getter copy and setter current selected/tick. Save/read hooks retain the existing player-custody migration owner; this is not a new immunity mechanism.

InventoryMixin returns a static dummy cobblestone stack from selected-slot getFreeSlot lookup while carrying; it does not insert a real cobblestone item. setPickedItem, pickSlot and swapPaint are canceled at HEAD while carrying. These local inventory restrictions have no own denial-reason receipt or actual native transfer proof.

Forge HIGH RightClickBlock ignores already-canceled and client-side events; pickup passes a posted BreakEvent cancellation predicate. Existing carrying branch calls placement then unconditionally marks success, denying useBlock/useItem and canceling with SUCCESS. Placement internals not newly read, so actual placement success is not established.

Forge entity placement callback posts a FinalizeSpawn checkSpawn but returns outer RightClickBlock event.getResult()!=DENY. This literal result-object mismatch is not a new semantic family and was not reproduced; no claim about native dispatch consequences.

Forge EntityInteract tries pickup only when not carrying, cancels with SUCCESS only when helper returns true. Existing ENTITY/PLAYER carry attempts stacking without checking result here. Final native interaction/stack outcome not expanded.

Pickup general gates require both hands empty, range, no existing carry, pressed key, different player.tickCount from stored carry.tick, and non-spectator/non-adventure. This last-write same-tick gate is not evidence of an authenticated attempt ID, acknowledgement or once-per-hit feedback.

Entity pickup rejects nonzero invulnerableTime, removed targets and another owner's tame animal. List refusal can be bypassed for allowed babies; noncreative hostility/size restrictions, pickup condition, callback and script predicate then apply. These predicates do not prove damage immunity or final capture.

Player pickup additionally checks pickupPlayers and creative asymmetry, ejects/stops prior riding, runs optional script command, then calls otherPlayer.startRiding(player) without checking its boolean. It sends start-riding packet, sets carry PLAYER, swings, requests sound, writes carry and returns true. Neither helper true nor sound proves native attachment. Nonplayer branch snapshots and removes entity under already accepted custody domain.

EntityMixin positionRider cancels and moves only when actual hasPassenger plus player/player and PLAYER carry. onPassengerTurned clamps relative yaw ±30 for the carry predicate. getDismountLocationForPassenger HEAD clears carry and sends false packet to cast ServerPlayer carrier; no cancellation and no explicit server-only guard there. No native call order or safe cast/runtime assertion.

CarryOnCommon server carry tick runs optional script loop before creative/slowness early return. That return also skips inv.selected reset; otherwise it requests one-tick slowness and assigns stored selected. Inventory mixins still have independent carry gates. Cosmetic effect flags and state writes are not actual movement/inventory acceptance evidence.

Forge attack and break hooks use hitWhileCarrying plus carry predicate: AttackEntityEvent cancellation, BreakEvent cancellation and BreakSpeed zero. Incoming LivingAttackEvent forwards to onPlayerAttacked; dropCarriedWhenHit requests placement on server before any final hurt result is established. Placement and damage native results not expanded.
